mentions.name: vibe-coding
mentions.description: A Claude Code plugin that automatically plays lofi beats in the background while Claude Code is working and stops the music when it finishes running. It can be added from the repo as a marketplace and plugin.
mentions.problem: Wanted lofi music to auto-play in the background while Claude Code works and stop when the run has finished, instead of playing it manually.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I built a claude code plugin, I call it vibe-coding. Can check out/add the repo as a marketplace and plugin from here: 
https://github.com/Vinayak-Shukla/vibe-coding
